figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id,1095-d.day_index recency_days,freq,money net_cents,r_score,f_score,m_score,CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day ORDER BY net_cents DESC, recency_days, freq

figures.title: 客户消费分层：三项指标各自打分，再加总分层

stages.label: ① 处理前：每位客户的三项原始指标（2025 年线上有效订单）
stages.note: 最近一次消费距截止日的天数、订单数、净额（分）——量纲不同，不能直接相加。

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id, 1095-d.day_index recency_days, freq, money net_cents FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day WHERE b.customer_id IN (3434,114,3862,4932) ORDER BY b.customer_id

stages.label: ② 三项各自按排名分成 5 档，得到 1 到 5 分（5 分最好）
stages.via: NTILE(5)：把所有客户按该指标排好序后均分成 5 档，不是固定的金额区间

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id, r_score, f_score, m_score FROM b WHERE b.customer_id IN (3434,114,3862,4932) ORDER BY b.customer_id

stages.label: ③ 三项得分相加，按总分划分层级
stages.via: 总分 ≥ 13 为高价值，≤ 6 为低活跃，其余为常规

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id, r_score+f_score+m_score total_score, CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment FROM b WHERE b.customer_id IN (3434,114,3862,4932) ORDER BY b.customer_id
